source.country_measure: views_ceil: privacy-protected upper bounds, not exact counts or people
source.topic_measure: Worldwide daily user pageviews for the selected article and language
source.historical_import: Retrospective retrieval from the same Wikimedia Analytics endpoints. Topics use the configured selection at import, not a reconstructed historical editorial selection. No absent dates are filled.

policy: First observed values and topic selection are retained. Missing dates are not zero. Country rankings or absent topic coverage may be added later only when absent.
